request.caption: Organic liquid drum and bass blended with chamber folk and slow-burn indie rock. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar and warm cello carry the song from the first bar, a steady piano ostinato and an unbroken drum groove hold it together, strings swell layer by layer. The verses stay sparse and intimate; fast rolling breakbeats with deep warm sub bass surge in underneath for every chorus; the bridge drops back to guitar, cello and voice; the final chorus is the fullest, and the outro returns to the fingerpicked guitar alone. Warm close-miked female lead vocal in slow half-time phrasing, long held notes, every word sung clearly, clear English diction. Wooden and earthy on the surface, a rush underneath, cinematic, hopeful, quietly strong
